visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair wearing a black face mask and a black t-shirt with a monster graphic peeks through a sliding wooden-textured door. One man wears a black tank top and the other wears a black t-shirt and glasses; both are holding smartphones in a landscape orientation as if playing a mobile game. (3) The two men on the sofa look up, point at the man in the mask, and appear to be laughing or mocking him. The man in the mask stands before them, holding his phone vertically, looking distressed as evidenced by his narrowed eyes and hunched shoulders. (4) The scene shifts to the man in the mask in a hallway area with white walls and a blue informational poster. He looks down at his phone screen, which displays a game interface with a purple prompt box. He begins to jump and wave his arms frantically, wearing pink shorts. (5) A series of rapid-fire cuts show the man in the mask in various high-energy poses: being playfully 'strangled' by the other men, showing a framed photograph of himself in a yellow traditional Chinese emperor costume, and pointing to a phone screen showing a rank or profile. (6) The final phase takes place near a kitchen area with a white refrigerator covered in various anime stickers (Dragon Ball). The man in the mask continues his dramatic, rhythmic movements, looking directly into the camera while the other men reappear in the background, joining in the high-energy, meme-style posing.

Each visual cut is accompanied by a sharp percussive transient in the BGM. (6) The final section maintains a hyper-dense audio environment where high-arousal shouting and laughter are layered over the continuous, energetic electronic beat until the track abruptly ends.
